name: Distributed NeRF Optimization
aliases: Distributed NeRF Optimization — Consensus ADMM for NeRF, Di-NeRF, Di-NeRF Distributed Optimization
definition: A distributed training framework for Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) where multiple robots collaboratively learn a global scene representation and relative camera poses without sharing raw data, using Consensus ADMM to achieve consensus on global NeRF parameters.
summary: Distributed NeRF Optimization is a collaborative framework enabling multiple robots to jointly reconstruct a global Neural Radiance Field and refine camera poses without sharing raw sensor data.
